card.title: Fair Exchange
card.instruction: Price every favor in time, effort, inconvenience, or future obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll wash up if you do two shopping trips.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This pan has dried cheese. Rates have changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then one trip and the detergent.

mechanism: A prices washing a pan in shopping labor and adjusts the rate when B reduces the difficulty.
confusable: Unlike fixed payment, the favor's concrete inconvenience must change the exchange terms.
comparison: D46-a discounts soaked cheese while adding detergent; D46-b reprices moving stairs and lost cricket in painter-hours.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
